discrepancy_fixed: The obvious rule (count **.html under dist/) gave 1 route for the starter and still 1 after 3 client routes were added via react-router, contradicting the hand count of 4 <Route path> entries in src/main.jsx; the rule was therefore defined as router-config-based rather than build-output-based.
file_to_url: strip dist/ prefix; index.html => '/'; for multi-entry builds each emitted **/*.html maps to '/<relpath minus .html>'. For a client-routed SPA build all routes are served by the single emitted dist/index.html, so file->URL mapping cannot enumerate routes: count distinct `path` values in the client router config in src/ instead (fall back to 1 if no router exists).
gotchas: vite build of a client-rendered SPA emits exactly one dist/index.html regardless of client route count: after adding 3 react-router routes (4 total), dist/ still contained only dist/index.html.
Counting **.html under dist/ therefore undercounts SPA apps; the 85-pages-reported-as-1 failure mode reproduces exactly on the starter with a router installed.
vite build emits no sitemap, no route table, and no per-route manifest; the only verifiable route source for a client-routed app is the router config in src/ (e.g. <Route path=...> in src/main.jsx).
dist/assets/** (hashed js/css), public/ copies (favicon.svg, icons.svg) and imported images are never pages and must be excluded from any html-count heuristic.

Multi-entry builds (build.rollupOptions.input) DO emit one html per entry flat under dist/ (verified: index.html + about.html from two entries); the SPA trap applies to client-routed single-entry builds, so check whether a router or multi-entry config exists before choosing the counting method.
Dynamic client routes such as /blog/:slug are never materialized in build output; they appear only in the router config.
second_source_of_truth: hand count of <Route path=...> entries in the client router config in src/ (src/main.jsx); vite build emits no sitemap or route table
version_tested: vite 8.3.1, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.1, react 19.3.0, react-dom 19.3.0, react-router-dom 7.18.4, node v24.20.0
